summary: Python code quality is solid (error handling, custom exceptions, dependency injection for testing). Workflow structure is mostly sound (appropriate triggers, least-privilege perms, v4 action pins). Critical failures: (1) No test files exist — workflow runs `pytest tests/ -v` but tests/ dir missing entirely, violating TDD requirement. (2) Workflow doesn't execute act tests as specified; task mandates all tests via act, but workflow only runs script once. (3) bash script references missing fixtures (case-clean). (4) Error handling bug in workflow: `|| echo "exit_code=$?"` won't execute after failure. (5) No type hints despite Python 3.12. (6) Repeated code: npm_license_lookup / pypi_license_lookup structure similar (lines 20–29, 33–47). Incomplete & untestable as delivered.
